verdict.rationale: Gram's documented purpose is comprehensive tool-call logging, audit trails, and usage tracking across teams (gram-docs-5, gram-docs-19, gram-docs-25, gram-docs-29) — there is no documented user- or admin-facing opt-out or disable-telemetry setting; the one mention of 'configure telemetry delivery' (gram-docs-22) refers to routing telemetry, not disabling it. Given the product's core function is enterprise-wide observability/governance, no evidence shows a mechanism for an individual AI-native user to opt out of tracking.
